title: Cancel, X and Escape dismiss the dialog without deactivating; clicking outside does not dismiss it
custom_preconds: 1. The Deactivate dialog is open for a rep with assignments.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Cancel" button; re-open and click the "X" close icon; re-open and press Escape.
2. After each dismissal, check the staff member's active status.
3. Re-open and click outside the dialog.
custom_expected:
1. The dialog has a "Cancel" button (red outline) and an "X" close icon; it dismisses on Cancel, X, or Escape.
2. Any dismissal leaves the staff member's active status unchanged.
3. Clicking outside the dialog does NOT dismiss it.
